title: Apply lobby profile readiness and host-only settings safely
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md, docs/design/SWARM-BRIEF-v0.md, docs/design/RULES-SPEC-v1.md and the listed sourceRefs before editing. The imported Rules Spec v1 is the canonical engine contract; the earlier prototype/T01-T10 interfaces are baseline compatibility, not current gameplay rules. Do not restore approval votes, Repair/Sabotage buttons, Witness or five-node tracks. Preserve original IP and engine independence from Firebase/UI/Node. Edit only ownership; publish APIs only through explicitly owned package entrypoints, preserving baseline exports. Use original synthetic fixtures, scoped tests/lint/typecheck and npm run check. Do not commit, push, open PRs, spawn agents, provision/deploy services, access credentials or alter swarm budget. Implement approved alias/avatar/ready updates for the verified current member and host-only lobby settings/kick operations. Repeated aliases remain allowed; avatar changes never change identity. Host can update declared pre-match capacity,bot-fill/difficulty,visibility/passcode settings and timer enum only while the room is in lobby. Validate affected capacity/roster and hash passcode changes through the approved seam; never allow host kick/settings to bypass match Disconnect powers or change a live deadline. Use atomic revision/idempotency and publish safe A057 metadata. Do not guess host-transfer/host-loss behavior absent from the supplied sources; fail safely and preserve state until the narrow lifecycle decision is approved. Support approved explicit pre-game leave/revoke membership intent in the same lobby-only boundary. Do not turn a client menu/navigation action into a global pause or silently implement an unapproved host-transfer/live-game elimination policy.
acceptance: Members can edit only their own profile/readiness; only the verified host can change lobby settings or remove a pre-game member.
Alias/avatar edits preserve principal/seat identity and permit duplicates while configured capacity remains valid.
Active-match timer/settings/kick requests cannot pause,reset or bypass the canonical engine/permanent Disconnect rules.
Tests cover stale/concurrent updates,unauthorized changes,passcode rehash privacy and unchanged state on invalid lifecycle requests.
